_readme: Names a listing uses that no Census source carries, with the nearest place that does. Applied by scripts/build-coords.py so a reader typing the listing's own name resolves, and so the name keys the served-area match. Every entry needs a reason: this file is the only place in the coordinate build where a name is mapped to a coordinate it is not literally the name of.

Charleston.why: Charleston, Oregon is an unincorporated community inside Coos Bay's urban area with no census designated place and a population under 1,000, so neither the Census place file nor GeoNames carries it. It appears in a listing's served areas (Curry County and Coos County coverage). Mapped to Coos Bay, about 5 miles east, which is its postal address (ZIP 97420).

Nacimiento Lake.why: The Census files it as 'Lake Nacimiento CDP'; the listing and the locals say it the other way round. Same place.

Carmel Valley.why: The Census carries the community as 'Carmel Valley Village CDP'; the listing names the valley it sits in. Same place.

Pebble Beach.why: An unincorporated community with no census designated place and no row in the Census place file at all, so the only coordinate any source carries is the ZIP area that serves it, 93953. That ZCTA centroid is the Census's own.

California Valley.why: A small community on the Carrizo Plain, not a Census place. 93453 is the ZIP area that serves it, and its centroid is the Census's own coordinate.

Sun Valley.why: The Census place file carries Sun Valley, NEVADA, 500 miles away, so this name resolves to the wrong place and no check can see it. The Los Angeles neighbourhood of the same name is only in the ZIP table, and 91352 is its ZIP.

Valencia.why: A neighbourhood of Santa Clarita, not a Census place. 91355 is its ZIP area, whose centroid is the Census's own.

Canyon Country.why: A neighbourhood of Santa Clarita, not a Census place. 91351 is its ZIP area.

Chatsworth.why: A Los Angeles neighbourhood, not a Census place. 91311 is its ZIP area.

Northridge.why: A Los Angeles neighbourhood, not a Census place. 91343 is its ZIP area.

Van Nuys.why: A Los Angeles neighbourhood, not a Census place. 91401 is its ZIP area.

Saugus.why: A neighbourhood of Santa Clarita. The only Saugus in the Census place file is in Massachusetts, so before the distance ceiling this resolved 2,600 miles from the listing. 91350 is its ZIP area.

Newhall.why: A neighbourhood of Santa Clarita; the Census name is only in Iowa. 91321 is its ZIP area.

Woodland Hills.why: A Los Angeles neighbourhood; the Census carries Woodland Hills in Utah. 91364 is its ZIP area.

West Hills.why: A Los Angeles neighbourhood; the Census carries West Hills in New York. 91307 is its ZIP area.

Sunland.why: A Los Angeles neighbourhood, not a Census place. 91040 is its ZIP area.

Tarzana.why: A Los Angeles neighbourhood, not a Census place. 91356 is its ZIP area.

Tujunga.why: A Los Angeles neighbourhood, not a Census place. 91042 is its ZIP area.

LaCanada/Flintridge.why: The listing writes the name without its accents or its spaces, and the Census spelling (La Canada Flintridge) does not match it either. 91011 is the ZIP area that covers it.

Lake Havasu.why: The listing and the locals shorten it; the Census carries it as Lake Havasu City. Same place.

North Scottsdale.why: A district of Scottsdale, not a Census place.

Happy Jack.why: A small community in Coconino County with no Census place. 86024 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Rimrock.why: A community in Yavapai County the Census place file does not carry. 86335 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Dolan.why: The listing shortens Dolan Springs. 86441 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Carson City.why: Nevada's capital is an independent city, and the Census place file carries no place row for it at all, so the state's own capital could not be resolved. 89701 is its ZIP area.

Centennial Hills.why: A Las Vegas neighbourhood, not a Census place.

Summerlin.why: A Las Vegas neighbourhood, not a Census place.

Ryndon.why: A small community east of Elko with no Census place. 89801 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Washoe City.why: A community in Washoe Valley with no Census place. 89704 is the ZIP area.

Bryce Canyon.why: The listing shortens it; the Census carries Bryce Canyon City.

Duck Creek Village.why: A community on Cedar Mountain the Census place file does not carry. 84762 is the ZIP area that serves it.

LaVerkin.why: The listing writes the town as one word; the Census carries it as La Verkin, two words.

Heber City.why: The Census carries the town as Heber city, which keys as heber; the listing writes Heber City, which is what the town is called locally.

Boise.why: The Census carries Idaho's capital as Boise City, which keys as boise city; the listing and everybody in Idaho say Boise.

Sagle.why: A community in Bonner County with no Census place. 83860 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Cahone.why: A community in Dolores County with no Census place. 81320 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Yellow Jacket.why: A community in Montezuma County with no Census place. 81335 is the ZIP area.

Hygiene.why: A community west of Longmont with no Census place. 80503 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Cameron.why: A small community on US-287 that the Census place file does not carry. The listing also names Ennis, the nearest town, and that is the coordinate used rather than a ZIP guessed at.

Alto.why: The Ruidoso and Alto community in Lincoln County. The Census place file carries Alto, TEXAS 475 miles away, so the name resolves to the wrong state; 88312 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Ira.why: A community in Scurry County with no Census place. 79527 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Joyce.why: A small community on SR-112 west of Port Angeles. The Census place file does not carry it and its ZIP area (98343) is not in the table, so the coordinate used is Port Angeles, which the listing itself names as its coverage.

Gordonville.why: A small community in Grayson County near Lake Texoma, with no Census place. 76245 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Pipe Creek.why: A community in Bandera County the Census place file does not carry. 78063 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Spicewood.why: A community across Burnet and Travis counties with no Census place. 78669 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Tarpley.why: A community in Bandera County with no Census place. 78883 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Cypress.why: A Houston suburb the Census place file does not carry as a place (it has Little Cypress, which is elsewhere). 77429 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Del Valle.why: A community south-east of Austin with no Census place. 78617 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Wallisville.why: A community in Chambers County with no Census place. 77597 is the ZIP area.

West Lake.why: The listing shortens it; the Census carries West Lake Hills city.

Central Heights.why: A community north of Nacogdoches with no Census place. 75961 is the ZIP area that serves it.

Woden.why: A small community in Nacogdoches County. Its own ZIP area (75978) is not in the table, so the coordinate used is Nacogdoches, the county seat the listing also names rather than a number guessed at.

Camp Bullis.why: A military reservation on San Antonio's north-west edge, not a town a reader lives in. The listing's own coverage is San Antonio.

Clear Lake City.why: A district of Houston, and the Census carries no place for it under that name.

Elm Mott.why: A community north of Waco with no Census place. 76640 is the ZIP area that serves it.

The Grove.why: A small community in Bell County that the Census place file does not carry and whose ZIP area is not in the table, so the coordinate used is Temple, the city the listing also names.

White River Jct..why: One Vermont listing spells the town the way a business would on a card, with the abbreviation; the Census place file carries only 'White River Junction'. Same place, and the other listing in the file already uses the full name.

Honolulu.why: The Census place file carries Hawaii's capital as 'Urban Honolulu CDP' (there is also an 'East Honolulu CDP'), so the name every listing, business and reader actually uses does not resolve. Same place.
